content.comment_body: Can someone help clarify what SMS command I should send from a mobile phone to the [product_name] CMR2040 to receive the current pressure value? Thanks.
Please refer to the manual for guidance.

Is this the correct syntax? Should I use VM to get the pressure reading from the analog sensor? Apologies, my English is not very strong so understanding the manuals can be difficult. If documentation were available in my language, I wouldn’t have so many questions.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking help on how to remotely obtain pressure data from the [product_name] CMR2040 using SMS commands. Although the manual is mentioned as a resource, language limitations make it difficult for the user to find the correct information, resulting in confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for straightforward instructions or example syntax for requesting sensor data by SMS, preferably offered in a language they understand.
